column3: “Red of garments” is rendered “garments of glowing colors,” and “stooping” as “Marching.”
“To Him distress” follows the Qere: “He was afflicted.”
“The spirit of His holiness” is rendered “His Holy Spirit.”
NASB makes the first line a question.
“Tumult of your inward parts” is rendered “The stirrings of Your heart.”
